en.name: Odd-Eyes Dimension Advent
en.effect:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: At the beginning of the Duel, add Pendulum Zones to your field. During this Duel, effect damage your opponent takes from your cards other than "Odd-Eyes" cards becomes 0.
2: Reveal 1 Level 6 or lower Spellcaster "Performapal" monster in your hand. Add 2 "Odd-Eyes" cards from your Deck to your hand. Then, Set 1 "Sky Iris" from outside your Deck to your field.
3: If you have an "Odd-Eyes" Ritual Monster on your field, or if only your opponent has cards on their field, Set 1 "Spiral Flame Strike" from outside your Deck.
